title: Compare and package the Italian Fibonacci trials
description: Run identical deterministic checks against both candidates. Compare correctness, geometry, explanations, latency, invocations, REWORK, and recorded token/cache fields. Preserve missing accounting as missing. Select or reconcile a canonical product through Quality and manager acceptance, then create the bounded public bundle required by the SPEC. Do not change or rebuild STARCHART.
design:
Purpose: Independently verify both candidates, select or reconcile the accepted product, and assemble the public product-plus-receipts directory.
Preconditions: Both isolated candidate transactions have returned terminal evidence and neither candidate has been made canonical merely because of model identity, speed, or estimated price.
Principal postcondition: A reviewer can reproduce the Fibonacci checks and trace every claim from the public bundle to frozen inputs, raw Beads, raw transactions, accounting, artifacts, and digests.
Work kind: verification
Build mode: none
Recipe:
acceptance_criteria: Quality records a criterion-by-criterion verdict; every Fibonacci relationship is classified; the bundle contains prompt, frozen SPEC, raw Bead prints, raw relevant transaction data, process notes, canonical product, verifier, machine-readable manifest, and SHA-256 inventory; any monetary calculation cites a dated price table and remains separate from raw accounting.
notes: STARCHART BLOCKED factory-3015c1a86f9da8ab5ce78887aa8bb5cb: Final publication requires missing transaction evidence and an independent Quality verdict plus manager acceptance, which this worker cannot provide. Decision needed: Can Aloeus supply the immutable transaction exports and complete independent Quality review plus manager acceptance?

dependencies.title: Italian Fibonacci controlled model comparison
dependencies.description: Run Italian Fibonacci as a controlled product exercise through the accepted STARCHART rail, comparing isolated Luna and Sol candidates from one frozen SPEC and delivering a self-contained public product-plus-receipts bundle.
dependencies.design: Two isolated implementation transactions receive identical inputs; a separate verification unit compares correctness, process, accounting, and provenance without changing the accepted STARCHART runtime.
dependencies.acceptance_criteria: Independent Quality accepts a canonical product; raw Beads and transaction records, available accounting, process notes, reproducible verification, final artifacts, manifest links, and SHA-256 digests form a distribution-quality evidence directory.

dependencies.title: Produce the Italian Fibonacci Sol candidate
dependencies.description: Implement only the Italian Fibonacci product under a Sol worker. Use a transaction-specific output area, preserve exact inputs and accounting returned by STARCHART, and do not inspect or modify the Luna candidate. Do not rebuild or modify STARCHART.
dependencies.design:
Purpose: Implement the frozen Italian Fibonacci specification using the current Sol worker in an isolated transaction.
Preconditions: The SPEC digest is exact; the Luna candidate is unavailable to this worker; the accepted STARCHART release is unchanged.
Principal postcondition: A self-contained Sol candidate and reproducible verification outputs satisfy the frozen Italian Fibonacci SPEC without reading the Luna candidate.
Work kind: implementation
Build mode: none
Recipe:
dependencies.acceptance_criteria: The program, tests, verifier output, artifact inventory, and limitations are returned durably; all deterministic SPEC checks pass or one concrete blocker is reported; transaction accounting is preserved without invented cost figures.
